batch: Phase C1 -- first slice of T2's 1,265-strong noun pool (top ~40 by frequency), a new and larger thread than the verb work. Not exhaustive -- nouns are far more homonym-prone (face=body-part vs. anger; hand=body-part vs. power; lord=divine vs. human), so this batch is deliberately smaller and more carefully verse-checked per item than the verb batches were.
method_note: Every characteristic-verb-style keyword match here was checked against a real verse (not gloss text alone) before inclusion, given how much more ambiguous nouns are than verbs. H0113 'lord' is a genuine dual-referent case (Dan.12.8/Gen.18.3 divine, Gen.18.12 human) -- dual-tagged T7+T8 rather than forced into one, matching the researcher's own confirmed 'dual membership is the norm' principle; which one applies in a given verse is Layer 2's job, not this pass's. Common body-part nouns (face/hand/eye/head/foot/entrails, generic senses) are deliberately NOT included -- they correctly stay excluded in T2, the same way pure copulas do for verbs.

new_clusters.description: T13 - Natural World: a strong referring to a natural phenomenon, element, or creature (water, fire, storm, animal, plant) that can be the endpoint of a characteristic's movement (e.g. fear of a storm, trust in water) -- named by the researcher early in this escalation (section 3c) but not built until now, when real candidates surfaced in the T2 noun-pool scan. Referent-identity classification, orthogonal to the thematic M-code axis; a code can carry both an M-cluster assignment and this one. Created 2026-09-08, escalation #1598, researcher-approved (as part of the original section 3c candidate list).
